title: Hotel Room Key App
scenario: A text says mobile-key setup requires your hotel login through a shortened link.

answers.A: Set up the key inside the hotel app or at reception.
answers.B: Enter your hotel password through the shortened link.
answers.C: Call the hotel using the number in your booking.
answers.D: Open the link but use a password you do not use elsewhere.

explanation: A shortened link hides the destination and can lead to a fake sign-in page. Use the hotel app or staff at reception.
proTip: Short links are for hiding destinations, not proving them.
